# Submission review probe

Copy this package into the configured user plugin directory, enable it in a fresh session and grant its server-code permission through the ordinary approval flow. Its hooks make no writes; three manually selected runtimes cover schema-less prose and character delegation. Keep `mode: disabled` for natural samples, or leave the package uninstalled.

For a labelled injected sample, set `mode` to `review-once` or `schema-once`, and set `targetRuntime` to the exact runtime being tested (for example `narrator` or `chat-mode-narrator/narrate`). `schema-once` is intended for story agents: it supplies an empty dialogue without a speaker, which cannot pass the current story schema/invariants. The provider’s original call ID is preserved. Each mode acts once per session/turn/runtime and allows subsequent submissions through. Counters survive within this observer instance; restart between samples rather than treating its in-memory ledger as durable state.

Read correction attempts, canonical business results, commit receipts and persisted messages separately. A valid revision within budget must recover; no valid revision means a lane failure. Run missing-submission/mixed-batch/refusal/commit-failure fixtures separately using the focused suites in the [acceptance guide](../../../docs/en/ship/real-model.md#submission-acceptance); those deterministic cases do not establish natural model quality.

For additional natural samples, keep injection disabled. Run `submission-review-probe/prose` manually in a fresh session and confirm its committed prose uses the host schema. With an existing character, run `submission-review-probe/delegate`; require one accepted `character-actor@1` child and a separate accepted parent submission, without an independent child story or exposed intent. Only this fixture’s actor should provide that contract for this sample. Missing characters or no child call are gaps, not passes. These executions are outside the 12 primary player inputs.
